messages:
maya: opened a compact migration PR for v1 -> v2 focused on minimal examples + CI smoke check. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4381 :wave:
tom: i'll take Go snippets and the single-line curl for CI. keep examples sync-only.
li: i'll draft a tiny Rust example and quick note about webhook header rename (X-Redwood-Event -> X-Rwdw-Event).
alex: add a clear embeddigns note: alias redwood-embed-v1 -> redwood-embed-v2 changes dims, re-index required. i'll add a one-liner under breaking-changes.
link-bot: found a 404 in the PR: /guides/embeds -> suggested /guides/embeddings/migration (auto-suggested).
maya: thanks. core python snippet for the migration smoke test (very small):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.responses.create(model="redwood-v2", input="Summarize this")
print(resp.output_text)
```
tom: Go snippet pushed to the branch (sync):
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
resp, _ := client.Responses.Create(ctx, redwood.CreateResponseParams{Model: "redwood-v2", Input: "Summarize"})
fmt.Println(resp.OutputText)
```
tom: CI curl for smoke test (single line): `curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"ok"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses | jq -e '.output_text'`
li: pushed a Rust minimal example. small ask: someone with Rust experience please verify types.
ci-bot: staging docs deploy queued after PR merge; will run docs-smoke job if present.
maya: can QA run the curl smoke test against staging and post results in this thread before we merge? aiming to merge today if green.
alex: added an "upgrade checklist" top-of-doc: update SDK, rename invoke -> responses.create, re-index embeddings if alias changed, run smoke, monitor latency.
maya: assigning reviewers @tom @li @alex. thanks all. :thumbsup:
